visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static dark background featuring a title card with large white and yellow text. A stylized logo of a person's head appears in the upper left corner. (2) A transition introduces an animation of a young girl with brown hair and a yellow shirt. She is leaning on her hand with a slight smile. The background is a vibrant gradient of pink and orange. Around her, colorful icons such as a rain cloud, a train, a seashell, a star, a fish, and ice cream float in the air. Her eyes are closed as if she is daydreaming, and her facial expressions are soft and content. (3) The scene shifts to the adult version of the same girl, now with longer hair and a blue dress. She stands against a dark purple background with two shadowy figures whispering into her ears on both sides. Her expression is one of sadness and anxiety, with downturned eyes and a slight frown. (4) The girl is seen sitting on a blue subway seat, surrounded by other passengers who are silhouetted or staring at their phones. She looks straight ahead with a vacant, depressed expression. The lighting is cold and clinical, typical of public transport. (5) In a bright office setting, the girl is seen holding a clipboard and standing next to a whiteboard with charts. She is dressed professionally in a purple blouse and blue skirt. Despite being in a productive environment, her eyes remain weary, and she looks slightly overwhelmed as she presents to a small audience of silhouetted figures. (6) A nighttime scene shows the girl lying in bed under a blue blanket. A crescent moon is visible outside a window. She is tossing and turning, her eyes wide open with dark circles underneath, indicating insomnia. The room is dimly lit with deep blue tones. (7) Flashing memory sequences appear, showing her spilling a drink at a counter, a boss figure pointing at a folder, and social circles where speech bubbles with random talk overlap. She looks distressed in these memories. (8) The girl stands before a mirror, staring at her reflection. She touches her cheek, appearing to inspect her physical health. The background is a simple indoor room with framed pictures. (9) The final phase shows a screen recording of a search bar where characters are being typed. The search results appear as a list of articles on a clean white background with a Google-like interface, focusing on the term '精神内耗'.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 精神内耗者的自白. [Logo]: 精神城. [Slogan]: (源自網路改編，來源附在資訊欄). (2) [Subtitle]: 首先，我們來看一個精神內耗者的自白. (3) [Subtitle]: 在我小的時候，我總覺得自己的想像力是一種天賦. (4) [Subtitle]: 腦海裡總是充滿各種畫面. (5) [Subtitle]: 無窮無盡的故事在腦中上演. (6) [Subtitle]: 讓我感到興奮、滿足. (7) [Subtitle]: 甚至有些得意. (8) [Subtitle]: 不過，長大後. (9) [Subtitle]: 我所認為的「天賦」卻成了一種折磨. (10) [Subtitle]: 我開始感到一種說不上來的疲憊感. (11) [Subtitle]: 腦袋裡的思緒和聲音讓我不得安寧. (12) [Subtitle]: 在白天，我還能用手邊的事. (13) [Subtitle]: 把這些亂七八糟的思緒暫時掩蓋掉. (14) [Subtitle]: 我還以為我找到了靜下來的方法. (15) [Subtitle]: 殊不知，是我太天真了. (16) [Subtitle]: 到了夜晚，一切都變了. (17) [Subtitle]: 黑暗中，我的腦袋像個失控的錄影機. (18) [Subtitle]: 不停的播放各種畫面. (19) [Variety]: 對不起!. (20) [Subtitle]: 我過往做過的錯事. (21) [Variety]: 下週的活動你來處理. (22) [Subtitle]: 我對未來的不安. (23) [Variety]: 也太好笑了吧. 真假啦. (24) [Subtitle]: 別人對我的評價. (25) [Variety]: 今天吃什麼? 不知道，你呢? 隨便吧. 隨便是什麼? 就是什麼都可以啊. (26) [Subtitle]: 甚至一些毫無意義的對話. (27) [Subtitle]: 那些聲音一遍又一遍的在回放著. (28) [Subtitle]: 躺在床上的我翻來覆去. (29) [Subtitle]: 閉上眼睛卻無法停下這無休止的思考. (30) [Subtitle]: 每次都要等到身體累到極限了. (31) [Subtitle]: 才得以關機. (32) [Subtitle]: 但那所剩的幾個小時的睡眠. (33) [Subtitle]: 總是感覺不夠. (34) [Subtitle]: 我開始懷疑是不是我得了某種病. (35) [Subtitle]: 但從任何角度來看. (36) [Subtitle]: 我又不是真的生病了. (37) [Subtitle]: 我沒有嚴重到需要吃藥. (38) [Subtitle]: 也不至於要看醫生. (39) [Subtitle]: 後來，我到網上尋找原因時才發現. (40) [Subtitle]: 這並不只有我一個人的問題. (41) [Subtitle]: 似乎很多人都在和這種內心的噪音奮戰. (42) [Subtitle]: 而這種狀態有一個專有名詞叫. (43) [Subtitle]: 「精神內耗」. (44) [Slogan]: 為什麼我一直在胡思亂想. [Slogan]: 精神內耗.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a gentle, finger-picked acoustic guitar melody in a moderate tempo. A male narrator provides a calm, clear introduction in Mandarin with a neutral tone. (2) A subtle whoosh sound effect transitions the audio as the narrator describes childhood. The music maintains its light, hopeful feel. (3) The music shifts to a more somber, lower-pitched piano arrangement with minor chords. Whispering voices (multivocal) and a low heartbeat SFX are introduced, creating a sense of tension and internal unrest. The narrator's voice becomes slightly more strained and breathy. (4) A series of chaotic sound bites are edited together: a muffled thud, a sharp mechanical click, and overlapping chatter/laughter from a social setting. These represent intrusive memories. (5) The audio environment shifts to a quiet indoor room tone with audible heavy breathing. The music remains a minimal ambient drone. (6) A sharp digital click SFX and the sound of rapid keyboard typing mark the final phase. The acoustic guitar returns at a lower volume, concluding with a final resonant chord as the narrator defines 'Mental Internal Friction'.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Personal Experience -> Conflict -> Resolution/Definition
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to explain the concept of 'Mental Internal Friction' (精神内耗) by using a relatable animated narrative. It transitions from the protagonist's happy childhood daydreaming to her struggle with social anxiety, overthinking, and insomnia in adulthood, ultimately providing a name for this state to help viewers identify and understand their own similar feelings.

high_inference.freeDescribe: This is an educational animation focusing on mental health. The shift in color palette and musical mode effectively mirrors the transition from a positive mindset to internal conflict.
